entries.content: The Warrior archetype relies on physical might. They favor Strength and Endurance. They gain advantage regarding physical attack rolls. They eschew magical studies.
The Mage archetype wields arcane forces. They favor Intelligence and Willpower. They receive advantage on spell casting rolls. Their playstyle requires managing spell points.
Sorcerers possess a unique magical curse. They cannot regenerate spell points through rest. They rely entirely upon Spell Absorption to regain power. They are formidable anti mages.
The Thief archetype excels in stealth. They favor Agility and Speed. They gain advantage on attack rolls when striking from surprise. They utilize finesse over brute force.
